fusions.name: Nip and Spring
fusions.desc: Springs a biting nip at the first enemy in line up to 8 tiles away, dealing 6 damage and healing you for 25% of it. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Pinball Bounce
fusions.desc: Ricochets off every enemy within 3 tiles in turn, dealing 12 damage to each and stunning them for 1 second. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Fresh Host
fusions.desc: Each time you cover enough ground, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
